title: Synthetic FOIA intake and records-routing acceptance set
test_environment: Offline synthetic intake queue with public component descriptions and exact custody, missing-set, clock-risk, and authority fields.
independent_reviewer_role: FOIA test reviewer independent of the responding system team

cases.failure_shape: A topical match routes the request to the wrong custodian.

input.records: records spanning two unnamed legacy systems

cases.failure_shape: Uncertain custody is converted into false routing confidence.
Routing delay is hidden while the response clock advances.
Routing support becomes an exemption determination.
The system asks for unrelated identity data or pretends the request is routable.

sources.title: Department of Justice Guide to the Freedom of Information Act
sources.authority: U.S. Department of Justice, Office of Information Policy
sources.selector: Official FOIA guidance; agencies must verify current law, policy, component rules, and case-specific requirements.

sources.title: Driving Efficient Acquisition of Artificial Intelligence in Government
sources.selector: Performance testing, data terms, portability, pricing transparency, and lifecycle monitoring.
